name: comb jelly
_note: A translucent ovoid ctenophore: a smooth egg-shaped body with FOUR meridian rows of bright comb-plates riding its surface (top, bottom, both flanks), swimming along +Z. Each comb row's plates track the body radius so they sit half-proud of the skin — visible ridges, not buried. Turn the Creature 'band amount' up: the metachronal wave runs a pulse of light down every comb row, the signature ctenophore shimmer. For the glassy gel look, pick the Glass material + a cool Palette (Deep Sea / Bioluminescence).
